coverage.route: Hushfeed home, Comments, Search, all available settings pages, restart and return
coverage.prerequisites: No preference writes during the core walk. Full qualification also needs pause, import, reset and restart restoration.

coverage.route: Cold launcher, native settings entry, onboarding, login, update and splash routes
coverage.prerequisites: Preserved account and signer, eligible login methods, and served prompts. Exercise each selected bypass against an unpatched control.

coverage.route: Served video comment sheet, gallery, album, voice composer, copy, sort, translation and send recovery
coverage.prerequisites: Authenticated account with server photo/voice entitlement, local owned media and an approved nonposting send fixture. Native gallery visibility and opening do not prove posting.
patches: Open the comments at full height

coverage.route: Native drama/video playback, end, loop, background, resume, progress, full screen and clear display
coverage.prerequisites: Served playable drama episodes and ordinary videos with stable ownership. Compare switches on/off and restore defaults.
patches: Fit the video to the screen
Stay on the video in full screen

coverage.route: Served home, tabs, promotion, save, follow and search affordances
coverage.prerequisites: Served videos and relevant promotions. Never interact with suggested people or publish/share content.

coverage.route: Video/photo download, native share, external handoff, offline storage and removal
coverage.prerequisites: Owned media, writable test destination and eligible download/duet/stitch controls. Verify output and preserve unrelated files.
patches: Disable the long press quick share

coverage.route: Contacts, installed apps, location, camera/microphone, capture and browser permission paths
coverage.prerequisites: Controlled permission state and an owned capture fixture. Restore temporary grants and check allowed as well as blocked controls.
patches: Allow screenshots and Circle to Search

coverage.route: Own request routing, P2P, proxy, certificates, SIM and region
coverage.prerequisites: Controlled reachable proxy and test endpoints, preserved network settings. Account and IP effects remain separate from local getters.

coverage.route: Own notification channels, suggestions, inbox/streak delivery
coverage.prerequisites: Controlled test account and sender plus served notification channels. No personal account or suggested person input.

coverage.route: Own inbox, activity, profile, search and LIVE search
coverage.prerequisites: Account owns eligible inbox/profile routes and served search results. Read-only navigation with no follow, message or post.

coverage.route: Manifest/app name, retained locale packs, native language, font, dates, haptics and transitions
coverage.prerequisites: Inspect exact output resources then exercise retained languages, system font and UI controls. Restore device/app settings.

coverage.route: Own image-cache and governor lifecycle under bounded observation
coverage.prerequisites: Controlled repeated content, background/foreground lifecycle and settings restoration. Compare unpatched native behavior.
